title: v1_128
content: # Visual Studio Code 1.128 Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/vs-code), [X](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=533687), [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/vscode.dev) --- _Release date: July 8, 2026_ **Update 1.128.1**: The update addresses these [security issues](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed+milestone%3A1.128.1). --- Welcome to the 1.128 release of Visual Studio Code. This release brings richer multi-chat agent sessions, generally available image support in Chat, and OS-level keyboard shortcuts. * [Multi-chat agent sessions](#multiple-chats-in-a-session-now-supports-claude-harness): Run several related chats in one Claude session to compare approaches and work in parallel. * [Quick chats](#chat-without-a-selected-workspace-in-the-agents-window): Ask a question in the Agents window without opening a workspace first. * [Copilot Vision](#copilot-vision-is-now-generally-available): Attach images and PDFs to Chat by pasting, dragging, or dropping them, now generally available. * [Browser tab placement](#configurable-placement-of-integrated-browser-tabs): Choose where integrated browser tabs open: the active group, a dedicated side group, or a separate window. * [OS-level keyboard shortcuts](#os-level-keyboard-shortcuts): Trigger VS Code commands with keybindings that work even when VS Code isn't focused. Happy Coding! ---
